summary: Round-2 fix commit 8abc428 cleanly applies the 6 in-scope round-1 findings (#1, #2, #4, #6, #7-test rename, #8-upper bound) plus a bonus residual-attribute clarification in openSession. The two SKIPPED findings (#3 InterruptedException early-return, #7 InOrder spy → id compare) are correctly justified — both preserve audit semantics / satisfy AC respectively. No regressions: List.of is no longer fully-qualified, forgotKey is grouped with bruteEmailKey/bruteIpKey at the trailing helpers, me()'s 4-clause guard has explanatory Javadoc, rotatePasswordAndTerminateSessions has the load-bearing ordering comment, dummy-delay test has a 500ms upper bound with rationale, and the IT poll removal is safe (EventService.logEvent is sync post-Task-5 and the new filter narrows by userId so cross-test event pollution can't false-positive). Awaitility import is still used by 3 other call sites — no orphaned import. Spec drift for register signature (#5) is correctly deferred to decisions.md per disposition note. No new code-quality issues introduced.
